literal_meaning: পিঠ বা শরীরের শক্তি খাটানো (straining one's back or body)
similar_in_english: work one's fingers to the bone
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে গতর খাইয়া কাজ করে, কিন্তু ফল পায় না।
জীবনে সফল হতে হলে গতর খাটাতে হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: He works his back off but gets no reward.
To succeed in life, you have to put your back into it.
note: This idiom reflects the value of physical labor in traditional Bengali society, often used to emphasize the necessity of effort for survival.
